primaryReferences.title: PBRT4 Radiometry
primaryReferences.use: Flux isW;incoming/outgoing flux per area is irradiance/radiant exitance inW/m²;radiance is directional density and stays constant along empty-space rays.

primaryReferences.title: PBRT4 Point Lights
primaryReferences.use: Point-light sample uses inverse squared source distance;spotlight has inner/outer transition and projection lights map an image into a cone.
